title: pickTrackerModelFromRuns
responsibility: Choose a Tracker model using outcomes from finished runs of similar work. An explicit model pin bypasses history.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns.item
inputs.description: The Tracker item whose task kind, project, eligibility and optional model pin guide selection.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns.finished
inputs.description: Reads finished Tracker run rows. It is called only when the item has no explicit model pin.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns.cfg
inputs.description: Optional ladder, routing and minimum sample configuration for learning from prior runs.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns.now
inputs.description: Optional epoch milliseconds used for model eligibility. The selector defaults to the current time.

inputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns.evidence
inputs.description: Failed attempts and quality incidents on this item.

outputs.name: pickTrackerModelFromRuns
outputs.description: The selected model and effort, with the task classification and reason for the choice.
